entities.name: Mara
entities.description: A scarred and proud veteran of the war against the Eldrazi who defended Sea Gate on Zendikar.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: City on Zendikar that Mara helped defend against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where Mara fought the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titanic invaders of Zendikar who corrupted Mara.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who met Mara at Sea Gate while looking for Nahiri.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker Jace Beleren was looking for at Sea Gate.

events.summary: Mara holds back a swarm of broodlings so a dozen people can escape, but is overrun and corrupted by the Eldrazi.
events.quote: she held back a swarm of broodlings and helped a dozen people escape the chaos

events.summary: Mara meets Jace Beleren at Sea Gate and shares her story with him.
events.quote: She met Jace Beleren at Sea Gate when he returned there looking for Nahiri

relations.note: She fought them at Sea Gate and was corrupted by them.
relations.quote: she was ultimately overrun and corrupted by the Eldrazi

relations.note: She shared her story with him.
relations.quote: she shared her story with him
